name: Russia–Ukraine
value: Dymer strike 22 Nov; corvette sunk off Libya
summary: Russian strikes hit flats in Dymer and Kryvyi Rih; Zelensky says Ukraine sank a Russian corvette off Libya on 22 Nov
state: A Russian strike partly destroyed a block of flats in Dymer, Kyiv region, on 22 Nov, with 14 people reported missing, as Zelensky pressed the US for anti-ballistic interceptors (Politico). Russian attacks on Kryvyi Rih killed a child and a young woman, taking the regional toll to 11, officials said (AP, 21 Nov). Zelensky said on 23 Nov Ukraine sank a Russian corvette near Libya's coast and hit a cargo ship in the Baltic, widening the war's reach (Reuters). Repeated mass-casualty strikes keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to Ukraine. Strikes on energy infrastructure are causing power cuts across Ukraine as winter sets in.
rubric_hit: Mass-casualty strikes on cities, plus attacks beyond the front = Alert
